Annotates 21 clusters at `RNA_snn_res.0.8` and defines the 13-cluster trajectory subset. The SC and TA labels set here are what the ligand-receptor analysis consumes.

Paths are relative to this `scripts/` directory.


# Load Required Libraries
```{r chunk-01}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(SingleR)
library(celldex)
library(readxl)
library(harmony)
```

# Set Working Directory
```{r chunk-02}
```

# Load Seurat Object
```{r chunk-03}
seu <- readRDS("../data/seu-obj-V5-Annotation-pre-removal-2025-03-26.RDS")
```

# Join Layers (required for Seurat v5 objects before downstream processing)
```{r chunk-04}
seu <- JoinLayers(seu)
#counts <- LayerData(obj)
```

# Fetch reference - Immgen Data
```{r chunk-05}
ref <- fetchReference("immgen", "2024-02-26")
ref_2 <- fetchReference("mouse_rnaseq", "2024-02-26")
```

# Run SingleR Cell-Type Prediction Using ImmGen Reference
```{r chunk-06}
# Main-level and fine-level label predictions using the ImmGen reference
pred.immgen.labels <- SingleR(test = seu[["RNA"]]$counts,ref=ref,assay.type.test=1,labels = ref $label.main)
pred.immgen.fine.labels <- SingleR(test = seu[["RNA"]]$counts,ref=ref,assay.type.test=1,labels = ref $label.fine)
```

# Run SingleR Cell-Type Prediction Using Mouse RNAseq Reference
```{r chunk-07}
# Main-level and fine-level label predictions using the Mouse RNAseq reference
pred.mouse_rnaseq.labels <- SingleR(test = seu[["RNA"]]$counts,ref=ref_2,assay.type.test=1,labels = ref_2$label.main)
pred.mouse_rnaseq.fine.labels <- SingleR(test = seu[["RNA"]]$counts,ref=ref_2,assay.type.test=1,labels = ref_2$label.fine)
```

# Store SingleR Predictions in Seurat Metadata
```{r chunk-08}
# Add ImmGen and Mouse RNAseq main/fine label predictions to the Seurat object metadata
seu@meta.data$predicted_main_labels_immgen <- pred.immgen.labels$labels
seu@meta.data$predicted_fine_labels_immgen <- pred.immgen.fine.labels$labels

seu@meta.data$predicted_main_labels_mouseRNAseq <- pred.mouse_rnaseq.labels$labels
seu@meta.data$predicted_fine_labels_mouseRNAseq <- pred.mouse_rnaseq.fine.labels$labels


```

# Export SingleR Prediction UMAP Plots to PDF
```{r chunk-09}
# Save UMAP plots coloured by SingleR predicted cell-type labels
pdf("../outputs/SingleR-Prediction-UMAP-plots.pdf")
DimPlot(seu,group.by = "predicted_main_labels_immgen")
DimPlot(seu,group.by = "predicted_main_labels_mouseRNAseq")
DimPlot(seu,group.by = "predicted_fine_labels_mouseRNAseq")
dev.off()
```

# Export SingleR Score Heatmaps to PDF
```{r chunk-10}
# Heatmaps showing per-cell prediction scores, grouped by existing narrow and broad cell-type annotations
pdf("../outputs/SingleR-Prediction-Scores-Heatmap.pdf")
plotScoreHeatmap(pred.mouse_rnaseq.labels,clusters = seu@meta.data$cell_type_narrow)
plotScoreHeatmap(pred.mouse_rnaseq.labels,clusters = seu@meta.data$cell_type_broad)
dev.off()


```

# Subset to Trajectory Cell Types and Generate UMAP Plots
```{r chunk-15}
# Clusters to keep for trajectory analysis (from "Keep for trajectory" column in annotation file)
clusters_to_keep <- c(0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 15, 18, 19)

seu_subset <- subset(seu, subset = RNA_snn_res.0.8 %in% clusters_to_keep)
```

```{r chunk-16}
# Trajectory cell-type annotations (subset of res 0.8 clusters kept for trajectory analysis)
trajectory_annotations <- c(
  "0"  = "SC",
  "1"  = "Proximal enterocytes-1",
  "2"  = "Proximal enterocytes-3",
  "3"  = "TA",
  "5"  = "TA",
  "6"  = "TA",
  "7"  = "TA",
  "8"  = "Pre-enterocytes-2",
  "9"  = "SC",
  "10" = "Pre-enterocytes-1",
  "15" = "Proximal enterocytes-2",
  "18" = "Distal enterocyte-1",
  "19" = "Distal enterocyte-2"
)

seu_subset@meta.data$trajectory_cell_type <- trajectory_annotations[as.character(seu_subset@meta.data$RNA_snn_res.0.8)]
```

```{r chunk-19}
multi_sample_pipeline <- function(merged_seu_obj, split_col = "orig.ident", res_cols = "RNA") {
  
  if (res_cols == "SCT") {
    merged_seu_obj <- SCTransform(merged_seu_obj, verbose = FALSE)
  } else {
    merged_seu_obj <- NormalizeData(merged_seu_obj)
    merged_seu_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(merged_seu_obj)
    merged_seu_obj <- ScaleData(merged_seu_obj)
  }
  
  merged_seu_obj <- RunPCA(merged_seu_obj)
  # assay.use was removed in harmony v1.0+; use reduction = "pca" instead
  merged_seu_obj <- RunHarmony(merged_seu_obj, reduction = "pca", group.by.vars = split_col, reduction.save = "harmony")
  merged_seu_obj <- RunUMAP(merged_seu_obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:40)
  merged_seu_obj <- FindNeighbors(merged_seu_obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:40)
  merged_seu_obj <- FindClusters(merged_seu_obj, resolution = c(1:10 / 10))
  
  return(merged_seu_obj)
}
```

# Subclustering on Trajectory Subset

## Build Neighbour Graph and Find Subclusters Using Existing Harmony Reduction
```{r chunk-20}
# The harmony reduction is already present in the subset object (carried over from the parent object)
# No need to re-run PCA or Harmony - use the existing embedding directly
seu_subset <- RunUMAP(seu_subset, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:40)
seu_subset <- FindNeighbors(seu_subset, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:40)
seu_subset <- FindClusters(seu_subset, resolution = c(1:10 / 10))
```


```{r chunk-21}
pdf("../outputs/Subset-epithelia-trajectory_cell_type_plots.pdf")
DimPlot(seu_subset,group.by = "trajectory_cell_type",label = TRUE)
DimPlot(seu_subset,group.by = "Location")
DimPlot(seu_subset,group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.5")
dev.off()
```
